name: Otohime Moeko
source:
Class: Magical Angel
Skill: Don't Call It Moe~!

The best and the most popular idol in Japan. [url=/c4521]Kiryuu[/url] has to fight crowds just to get near her. She challenges Kiryuu for possession of her school. Even after marrying Kiryuu she continues her idol career, so their relationship has to remain a secret.
